unresolved_decisions: Choose a Project Management System or explicitly skip PM integration.
Choose and identity-verify the Development AI agent pool available in the current host before privileged worker dispatch.

Finalize deployment-jurisdiction retention/legal policy before production release.
notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 started with the Rust native audio workspace at commit 047d974c2dd5b5f65b51a63311fcd2ff84c46883 (2026-09-10 03:43 PKT). Audio frame/queue/bypass, device catalog/reselection, bounded stream recovery, engine-period validation and SharedCapturePlan cadence logic are implemented and CI verified. A dedicated Windows Audio Validation workflow now compiles, lints and tests vsn-windows-audio on hosted Windows. Windows run 34423457612 first verified native compilation; run 34423605516 passed the MMDevice runtime snapshot smoke; and on the same implementation head Ubuntu run 34424232264 passed full repository integrity while Windows run 34424232265 passed compile, Clippy and 14/14 Windows audio tests. Windows COM/MMDevice endpoint snapshot code is therefore platform-compiled and runtime-smoke verified in hosted CI. The default communications-capture IAudioClient3 activation/GetMixFormat/GetSharedModeEnginePeriod probe is Windows-compiled/tested and safely returns no probe if the hosted environment exposes no communications capture endpoint; controlled physical-microphone period values are not yet claimed. Event-driven WASAPI sample capture, runtime packet accumulation/reframing, physical hotplug/default-device recovery, virtual microphone routing and hardware latency/jitter evidence remain pending. WU-002 is not complete until approved calling applications consume processed/bypass audio through verified Windows routing with the required compatibility and performance evidence. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates.
